description: Convert a numeric value between compatible units of measure. Supports: length (mm, cm, m, km, in, ft, ft-us, yd, mi), area (m2, ha, ac), mass (mcg, mg, g, kg, oz, lb, mt = metric tonne / 1000 kg, t = US short ton / 907.18 kg), volume (mm3, cm3, ml, cl, dl, l, kl, m3, km3, tsp, Tbs, in3, fl-oz, cup, pnt, qt, gal, ft3, yd3), volume flow rate (l/s, m3/s, gal/min), count (ea, dz), temperature (C, F, K, R — non-linear conversions handled), time (s, min, h), speed (m/s, km/h, kph, mph, m/h or mi/h = mile per hour, knot, ft/s), pace (min/km, min/mi), pressure (Pa, kPa, MPa, hPa, bar, torr, psi, ksi), current (A, mA, kA), voltage (V, mV, kV), energy (J, kJ, mWh, Wh, kWh, MWh, GWh), power (W, mW, kW, MW, GW), reactive power (VAR, kVAR), apparent power (VA, kVA), reactive energy (VARh, kVARh), frequency (Hz, kHz, MHz, GHz, THz, rpm, deg/s, rad/s), illuminance (lx, ft-cd), digital storage (b, Kb, Mb, Gb, Tb, B, KB, MB, GB, TB), parts per (ppm, ppb, ppt, ppq), and angle (deg, rad, grad, arcmin, arcsec). Incompatible units (e.g., km to kg) return an error identifying the quantity mismatch.
name: ref_unit_convert

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `incompatible_units`: The source and target units measure different physical quantities. `unknown_unit`: One or both units are not recognized by the underlying library. `below_absolute_zero`: The input temperature is below absolute zero (0 K = -273.15 °C = -459.67 °F). `result_out_of_range`: The converted result, in either sign, is larger in magnitude than the largest double-precision number (1.7976931348623157e308). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

result_precision.description: Human-readable rounded form of the result.

title: Unit Conversion
